disposition.reason: The applicant appeals the Plymouth panel's denial of a conditional use permit to subdivide an 83.5-acre parcel into five lots. The documents never say the lots are for houses (the residential zoning district alone isn't a statement), so it is not new housing.

evidence.quote: appealed from a decision of a municipal panel1 of the Town of Plymouth (the panel), denying approval of a proposed five-lot subdivision.
Applicant applied on April 22, 2008, for a conditional use permit to subdivide an 83.5-acre parcel of property into five lots.
Applicant has raised the question of whether the application was deficient for failure to include “affordable housing.”

judgments.note: Reread: no passage says the five lots are for houses or dwellings; a subdivision whose lots aren't stated to be for housing is not new housing.
